name: mutescroll
description: MuteScroll turns a public video link, or a file you upload, into timestamped text of the spoken words. It reads a public video link when it can reach it. Other links get a one-time upload path.

interface.longDescription: MuteScroll turns a public video link, or a file you upload, into timestamped text of the spoken words. MuteScroll reads a public video link when it can reach it. Other links get a one-time upload path. It returns the transcript and stops. Summaries, translations, and checks of claims stay in the chat. Support: mutescroll.xyz@gmail.com.
